name: @jfb/runtime
description: The website runtime that enhances Razor-rendered forms (ROADMAP section 4.2, ADR-0004): no runtime dependencies, one module entry and a chunk per feature, embedded in the Web assembly and served from /jfb/assets/runtime/; and the preview script, which only the preview's document loads (ADR-0203), from /jfb/assets/preview/.
